name: Spark Board
description: A collaborative AI canvas for creative thinking, clustering rough ideas, and turning selected notes into send-ready drafts.
permission_rationale: Spark Board stores only its own canvas state and uses the host AI client when the user explicitly asks it to expand, challenge, summarize, or draft selected cards.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Live App named Spark Board: an AI collaborative canvas for creative thinking and send-ready outputs.
